content_sections.heading: Reservation, PwBD Backlog & Ex-Servicemen Details
content_sections.text: Post 813 (Bengaluru, Technical Assistant – Mechanical): Reserved for PwBD-MD (Backlog Vacancy) Post 815 (Bengaluru, Technician 'B' – Electronic Mechanic): Reserved for PwBD-MD (Backlog Vacancy) Post 816 (Valiamala, Fitter): 1 of the 5 Valiamala posts reserved for PwBD (HH) For the PwBD-MD backlog posts (813 & 815), eligible disability categories are: (a) Low Vision (LV), (b) Hard of Hearing (HH), (c) One Arm (OA), One Leg (OL), Both Arms Both Legs (OAL), Dwarfism (Dw), Leprosy Cured (LC), Cerebral Palsy (CP), Orthopedically Handicapped (OH). If suitable PwBD-MD candidates are not available, other PwBD categories will be considered; if none are available, the vacancy reverts to UR. Of the 9 Fitter posts (Post No. 816), 2 posts are reserved for Ex-Servicemen.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for LPSC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Important: Applications will be received ONLY through online mode . The online recruitment portal is available strictly between 18.08.2026, 1400 Hrs and 04.09.2026, 1400 Hrs.

faq.question: Q1. How many posts has LPSC notified?
faq.answer: LPSC has notified 19 posts across Technical Assistant, Technician 'B', Draughtsman 'B', and Fireman 'A' categories, under Advt. No. LPSC/02/2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online recruitment portal closes on 04 September 2026 at 1400 Hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Maximum 35 years for Post Nos. 813 to 817, and 25 years for Post No. 802, as on 04.09.2026, with relaxation for OBC, PwBD, Ex-Servicemen, and other eligible categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: A 3-year Diploma in Mechanical or Chemical Engineering with First Class, depending on the discipline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the pay matrix?
faq.answer: Level 7 (₹44,900–₹1,42,400) for Technical Assistant, Level 3 (₹21,700–₹69,100) for Technician/Draughtsman, and Level 2 (₹19,900–₹63,200) for Fireman.

faq.question: Q6. Are there PwBD backlog vacancies?
faq.answer: Yes - Post Nos. 813 and 815 carry PwBD-MD backlog reservation, and one Fitter post (816) at Valiamala is reserved for PwBD (HH).
